units: points; page and top/left/baseline measured from the page top-left corner; start/end are UTF-16 offsets in the main story
precision: top/left/lastX are screen-quantised (+-0.3 pt); baseline/inkLeft and cell rectangles come from the 600 dpi PDF and are exact

lines.text: The harbour wall keeps the swell away from the moored boats, and the old
lamps along the quay come on one by one as the light fades behind the hills. A
few walkers stop to read the notice boards, and a dog sleeps in the doorway of
the chandler. Careful typesetting never relies on luck: every paragraph is
measured, every break is chosen, and the space around an illustration is set by
rules that can be written down. A reader notices only when those rules are broken, and then the page
feels wrong. The harbour wall keeps the swell away from the moored boats, and the old lamps along the
